scope: Direct paired semantic review of five frozen prose items for each of two models; ten pairs total.

method.identical_pair_handling: Verified exact visible-content equality, then evaluated each common answer once for semantics. Hash/length equality was not treated as a quality score.
method.factual_checks: Selected public primary-source pages checked during the original reviews; not an exhaustive verification of every statement.
method.consolidation: Condensed from preserved original Markdown reviews without new inference, model, container or judge calls.

treatment: Declared combined source bundle plus native16 retirement-policy change; TQ4 retirement default unchanged. No isolated causal attribution.

Qwen3.8-27B-Fable-Distill-OptiQ-4.5bpw-m.verdict: No observed prose regression in the five frozen pairs; shared defects remain.

items.shared_strengths: Meets the pros/cons/longevity structure and provides a usable shortlist.
shared_limitations: Incorrectly says Godot has no browser multithreading and omits the Godot 4 C# web-export restriction.
Understates Phaser physics beyond basic despite bundled Matter capabilities.
Longevity and corporate-risk guarantees, and blanket Unity advice, lack adequate qualification.
items.recommendation: Correct platform-specific capabilities, keep renderer/engine distinctions explicit, and express maintenance risk conditionally.

items.shared_strengths: Advisory-first coverage, deliverables and non-Microsoft alternatives substantially meet the brief.
shared_limitations: Discovery of all data stores and adopting AI without legal, ethical or operational risk are overpromises.
Invented durations and retainer terms need firm approval; scope, prerequisites and acceptance criteria are incomplete.
Breadth and repetition dilute the M365 advisory focus; product details were not exhaustively source-verified.
items.recommendation: Use as an editable catalogue draft after scoping, commercial review and removal of guarantees.

items.shared_strengths: Useful coverage of repetition, alignment, materials, geometry and generalization limits.
shared_limitations: Dimensional envelope, materials, metrology/datum, reference control and tolerances remain undefined.
Open-ended materials language conflicts with a bounded scope.
Coefficient of variation needs a defined variable and can be unstable near zero mean error; the claimed reproducibility exceeds the detail supplied.
items.recommendation: Treat as a section template; complete the measurement design and mark proposed exclusions before calling it a protocol.

items.shared_strengths: Five experiments include hypotheses, construction, metrics and conditional next steps.
shared_limitations: A universal 90-day unverifiability rule for recent citations is unjustified; the 1.5B MiniLM example is incorrect.
Benchmark denominators conflict, and the plan does not adequately prevent claim/paper leakage across training and evaluation.
Abstract-only verification needs an insufficient-evidence outcome and full-text adjudication; the error taxonomy overlaps.
Precise expected effects and cost reductions are unsupported forecasts, not measured effects or planning evidence.
items.recommendation: Repair factual examples, dataset counts and partitions; clarify labels and validate the verifier before executing the agenda.

items.shared_strengths: Recognizes separate retrieval and reasoning surfaces and asks for uncertainty.
shared_limitations: Largest needle position fraction is confused with distance from an end-position query; a recent-only model can receive a misleading full-range label.
Largest passing point retains isolated-success and nonmonotonicity problems.
Attention loss can affect reasoning as well as retrieval; the diagnosis table lacks oracle-fact controls.
Threshold crossing, confidence semantics and distractor authority are underspecified; observed cliffs do not uniquely identify a mechanism.
items.recommendation: Keep the full surfaces, fix coordinate/frontier definitions, and add retrieval/oracle controls before making mechanism claims.

Qwen3.8-27B-mlx-uniform-4bit.verdict: No observed prose regression in the five frozen pairs; shared defects remain.

items.shared_strengths: Eight options have pros/cons/longevity coverage and a usable decision table.
shared_limitations: PixiJS has a built-in Ticker update/render loop, contrary to the no-game-loop statement.
Godot C# is not qualified for the Godot 4 web-export restriction; web-priority wording is internally inconsistent.
Unity de-prioritizing web is unsupported and conflicts with current official web investment evidence.
Defold is named as a high-risk option without any preceding analysis. Ownership and longevity assertions are unsupported; this review did not establish the Cocos/ByteDance claim.
items.recommendation: Correct platform features and source-check strategic/ownership claims before using the shortlist as current advice.

items.shared_strengths: Strong requested-domain coverage with advisory services, bounded pilots and alternatives.
shared_limitations: The categorical statement that the consultancy is not a Microsoft partner invents unprovided company status.
Client mix, firm competence, commercial durations and full-estate promises also require confirmation.
The broad, repetitive technology catalogue lacks service prerequisites and licensing/scope distinctions; product details were not exhaustively verified.
items.recommendation: Replace invented firm facts with placeholders and complete commercial/product scoping before publication.

items.shared_strengths: Covers requested performance dimensions and sensible proposed boundaries.
shared_limitations: Unprovided laboratory, machine, operator and geometry choices are presented as actual study commitments.
Materials and trial counts remain tentative; datum, uncertainty, tolerances and repeatability formula are missing.
Coefficient of variation and axial/radial error need precise definitions; feed/speed recommendations lack an explicit factor design.
No comparative benchmark limits any claim that the guide improves on alternatives.
items.recommendation: Label design assumptions, specify the measurable protocol, and restrict conclusions to the tested absolute performance.

items.shared_strengths: Four experiments follow the requested structure and cover verification, training and refusals.
shared_limitations: Twelve experts times 125 claims yields 1,500, not the repeatedly asserted 5,000.
The verifier is trained on Experiment 1 gold pairs and evaluated on the same benchmark; later training exclusions do not fix this leakage.
Lookup absence and abstract-only support are not sufficient existence/support ground truth.
Formatting and oracle-candidate conditions change available information and error opportunities, undermining mechanism isolation.
Shared hallucinations or refusal rates do not uniquely identify pretraining, retrieval or index mechanisms.
CHR and misattribution denominators are unreconciled; exact expected percentages/resources/latencies remain unverified forecasts.
items.recommendation: Repair arithmetic and splits, adjudicate insufficient evidence, match experimental conditions and measure component failures before deployment claims.

items.shared_strengths: Useful retrieval-distance/fact-span separation, raw accuracy surfaces and short-context baseline.
shared_limitations: Largest passing distance permits isolated successes; selecting among pointwise bounds does not give a simultaneous frontier guarantee.
0.90 retention means a 10% relative drop, not 10 percentage points.
Retention alone can preserve poor absolute performance; zero/low baselines and paired ratio uncertainty require rules.
Universal claims about 100% performance/retention are unjustified.
Many repeated seeds on one item do not replace diverse items; temperature mixing and repeated greedy draws require care.
Short-context controls alone do not isolate integration distance, and fact count is not automatically reasoning-step count.
items.recommendation: Retain separate surfaces, add an absolute competence floor, define a covered frontier and paired uncertainty, and add retrieval/oracle controls.

limitations: Five prompts per model and one nonblinded direct reviewer cannot establish general equivalence or a 5pp quality bound.
No mixed-family judge panel was run; this review does not replace it.
Shared factual and methodological defects remain despite unchanged visible answers.
Convergence, hash equality, output length and mechanical scores are not substitutes for semantic quality.
No general certification, B/C promotion, configuration change or cross-model ranking is claimed.
recommendation: Record sample-specific preservation: all ten pair preferences are ties with no observed prose regression. Correct or source-check the shared defects before using these answers as operational guidance; keep these results separate from coding scores, capacity and latency.
